column1: # Source: HumCFS (Kumar R et al. 2019, BMC Genomics 19 (Suppl 9):985, doi:10.1186/s12864-018-5330-5), fragile_site_bed.zip from http://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/humcfs/download.html, sha256 70b8778c53e4f075ddd078e142eeb13100a2cb9ea1405f2f44c734519d071cf3. The page states no build and no licence. The coordinates are hg19 as given: 107 of 124 sites have both ends on UCSC hg19 band edges and several ends equal hg19 chromosome lengths, so they are not lifted. 124 sites in the archive (the paper counts 125; none on chr21 or Y). Rows as given, BED 0-based starts.
